exposure: homozygous intragenic out-of-frame deletion of 1.84 kb encompassing exons seven and eight of YY1AP1
cohort: A patient diagnosed with Grange Syndrome and their family members were investigated.
finding: The study identified a homozygous intragenic out-of-frame deletion in YY1AP1 (exons seven and eight) as the molecular cause of Grange syndrome in a patient and provided new insights into its phenotypic variability.
